sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Proposal for mechanical seal 24 mm (part:340010) from 2027
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. We understand the capacity constraint and would like to secure a firm, long-term arrangement.

We propose EUR 30.28/unit for 23,400 units per year, a 24-month contract and 56 days lead time, with the other enquiry terms unchanged.

Our buyer estimate is EUR 24.31 per unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty (cost:340010); we do not assert this is your actual cost.
LCI-C rose 2.66% from June 2025 to June 2026 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
PPI-C2219 rose 3.90% from August 2025 to August 2026 (idx:PPI-C2219@2025-08, idx:PPI-C2219@2026-08).

We recognise these input increases. Our proposal is therefore above our current EUR 29.89 to leave room for them.

In return, we offer two years of binding full volume and accept the longer 56-day scheduling time. In exchange, we ask for full allocation at the proposed price.

Could this package work for you?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

sup:70410.subject: Re: Proposal for mechanical seal 24 mm (part:340010) from 2027
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

We note your request for full allocation and the proposed 24-month contract at 23,400 units per year. While we can accommodate the extended lead time of 56 days and the increased volume, your proposed price does not reflect the current market realities for this specialized component. We can offer a revised price of EUR 31.80 per unit under these updated terms. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Which volume can you commit to? 

Our Angebot is a price of €31.80 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Legal Department: Please be advised that our general terms and conditions apply exclusively, and the quote lists our standard terms.

sup:70410.subject: Seal 340010 – three-year binding full volume at EUR 30.96
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised quotation and for accommodating the 56-day lead time and full volume.

To answer your question: we can bindingly commit to 23,400 units per year, and we now extend the term to 36 months. We also raise our price from EUR 30.28 to EUR 30.96/unit, with 56 days lead time and the other enquiry terms unchanged.

Supplier-wide rolling on-time delivery was 79.5% (sc:70410@2026Q3); we ask that this service record be recognised commercially in the price.
Our September forecast records a 10.1% change (fc:340010@2026-09); this is a forecast, not past-order growth, and it is separate from the binding commitment we propose.
We acknowledge the constraint described in the August report on allocating volumes in line with past call-offs (news:20260822-23); does this larger binding commitment support a full allocation at this price?

Could this package work for you?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

sup:70410.subject: Re: Seal 340010 – three-year binding full volume at EUR 30.96
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the news data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Furthermore, we have reviewed the delivery and forecast records; they do not alter the commercial basis for this specific component.

In exchange for the extended contract duration, we accept the 36-month contract term and confirm that this commitment secures full allocation. We reduce our price to EUR 31.60 per unit. Our offer stands at a price of €31.60 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Which volume can you commit to? This offer is valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
